description: Audits a repository, a live URL, or both against Product Hunt's launch guide and featuring guidelines; produces an evidence-backed readiness report, a validated launch kit, and a launch timeline in your timezone.

tools.name: audit_repo
tools.description: Collects launch evidence from a repository: metadata, assets with real sizes, copy signals, routes, providers.

tools.name: audit_url
tools.description: Collects launch evidence from a live site: head metadata, social images, CTAs, copy signals, broken links.

tools.name: capture_screenshots
tools.description: Takes gallery, full-page and mobile screenshots with Playwright, plus a thumbnail.

tools.name: check_launch_kit
tools.description: Validates every Product Hunt listing field against the form's limits and rules.

tools.name: launch_timeline
tools.description: Converts 12:01 AM PT launch time to a local timezone and lays out launch milestones.
